seed_ledger.name: ONE Nuclear power station 2 (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: ONE Nuclear's October 2025 SEC filing and investor summary describe an unnamed East Texas site with up to 1 GW of gas by 2028 and Rolls-Royce engines, site rights not yet secured. The September 2026 closing release places Project Barracuda (1.2 GW gas plant, 1 GW data center) in Louisiana, not Texas. No county, pipe or supplier is named anywhere. Gulf South P0197 is 0.2 km from the approximate GOGPT point but no source ties it. Railroad Commission, TCEQ, FERC and county records were searched through general web queries and showed nothing for this company. Searches run: 6. Sources checked: SEC 425 filing (site rights not secured), Quartr investor summary (East Texas 1 GW), closing coverage (Louisiana only), trade press (no county), EIA workbook not matched, TCEQ/FERC/RRC searches found nothing.

evidence.note: SEC 425 filing describing East Texas and Oklahoma sites, no pipe named

seed_ledger.name: Pecos power plant (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: Not a data center plant. TCEQ notice for permit 181523 (Pecos Power Plant LLC, 24 Wartsila engines, 4200 S Tolivar Street, Pecos, Reeves County) says it sells electricity to the grid. Mercuria and Continental describe a 452 MW ERCOT reliability plant, with a Texas Energy Fund loan. No source ties it to the Amazon and Pacifico GW Ranch campus in Pecos County, which has its own gas supply candidate. No gas pipe named for this plant. Searches run: 5. Sources checked: TCEQ notice (grid sale), Mercuria release (ERCOT plant, 2027), Wartsila release (452 MW), E&E News on GW Ranch (different plant and county), Texas Energy Fund coverage (no pipeline).

evidence.note: Mercuria and Continental release, 452 MW ERCOT plant in Pecos

seed_ledger.name: Texas's Data Center power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Frontier Infrastructure (Tailwater Capital) ordered 16 Baker Hughes NovaLT turbines, up to 270 MW, in May 2025 for behind-the-meter data center sites in Wyoming and Texas. No source names the Texas site, county or gas supplier, and no source uses the name Frontier Carbon Solutions for it. The GOGPT point is a generic Texas centroid, so the 0.5 km to Atmos Pipeline Texas means nothing. Searches run: 5. Sources checked: Baker Hughes release and trade coverage (no Texas site), turbomachinery and hydrocarbon engineering coverage (same), RRC, TCEQ, FERC and county searches found nothing.

evidence.note: Baker Hughes release, Wyoming and Texas sites unnamed
